meta_title: Full Circle Garden Design | Landscape Gardener Leeds
meta_description: Full Circle Garden Design creates stunning bespoke gardens across Leeds. Expert design, build and maintenance. Free consultation and quotes available.
hero_subhead: From concept to completion, we design and build gardens that work as hard as you do. Free consultation.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Build Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: We handle everything from initial concept sketches right through to planting and finishing touches.

services.title: Bespoke Garden Design
services.desc: Tailored designs that reflect your lifestyle and budget. We create detailed plans with 3D visualisations so you see your garden before a single spade breaks ground.

services.title: Garden Construction & Landscaping
services.desc: Professional hard landscaping including patios, decking, raised beds, water features and pergolas. Every project built to last with quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Planting & Aftercare
services.desc: Expert plant selection tailored to soil, aspect and maintenance preferences. We source quality stock and ensure proper establishment with seasonal aftercare advice.

services.title: Driveway & Patio Installation
services.desc: Stunning block paving, gravel and porcelain surfaces that enhance your home's entrance. Properly drained and finished to prevent settling and pooling.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Regular maintenance keeping your garden thriving year-round. Pruning, weeding, lawn care and seasonal updates to suit your schedule and budget.

services.title: Decking & Outdoor Structures
services.desc: Durable timber and composite decking, pergolas and garden rooms. All structures built to building regulations and designed for longevity in Yorkshire weather.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We help families write theirs.
about_para_1: Full Circle Garden Design & Construction was born from a simple frustration: watching friends and neighbours waste money on gardens that didn't work for them. We started in 2008 with just a van and a passion for creating outdoor spaces that earn their place. Today we've transformed over 500 gardens across Leeds and West Yorkshire, from compact courtyards to sprawling country estates.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our honest approach. We listen more than we talk, understand your budget from the start, and never push unnecessary extras. Our customers return again and again because they know we'll treat their garden—and their home—with the same care we'd give our own. Every member of our team is trained and experienced, and we back every project with comprehensive aftercare.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We'd been looking at our overgrown garden for two years, totally overwhelmed by the state of it. Full Circle came out, listened to what we actually wanted, and delivered something we never imagined was possible. The whole team was professional, tidy, and they didn't disappear the minute the job was done—they showed us how to maintain it. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Best money we spent on the house. The patio and planting work has completely changed how we use our garden. Brilliant design, fair pricing, and they finished on time. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a previous landscaper who left the job halfway through. Full Circle came in, sorted everything out, and actually improved on the original plan. Professional outfit. They're back next spring to add some structural planting—that's how much we trust them.
reviews.author: Kathy L.
